name: Textured crop
description: A compact cut with a textured top.
stylist_note: Discuss fringe length and how much natural texture to retain.

name: Crew cut
description: A short, tidy silhouette with minimal daily styling.
stylist_note: Discuss scalp coverage and clipper lengths; frequent trims may be needed.

name: Side part
description: A classic side-directed top with controlled volume.
stylist_note: Choose a part that works with your growth pattern.

name: Soft quiff
description: An elevated front and shorter sides.
stylist_note: Ask how to achieve height with your available styling time.

name: Textured pixie
description: A short layered shape with flexible fringe options.
stylist_note: Discuss face-framing pieces and your preferred ear coverage.

name: Curly taper
description: Natural texture on top with a tapered outline.
stylist_note: Ask about shrinkage and the shape between appointments.

name: Short natural coils
description: A compact rounded silhouette that retains natural texture.
stylist_note: Agree on moisturizing and detangling needs.

name: French crop
description: A short style with a forward fringe.
stylist_note: Discuss fringe weight and hairline comfort.

name: Classic bob
description: A clean outline around the jaw or above the shoulders.
stylist_note: Choose the perimeter length before cutting.

name: Layered bob
description: A medium silhouette with lighter internal layers.
stylist_note: Discuss how layers will fall without heat styling.

name: Curly bob
description: A rounded medium cut built around natural curl.
stylist_note: Ask for length planning that accounts for shrinkage.

name: Soft shag
description: A layered cut with movement and optional fringe.
stylist_note: Discuss how short the crown layers should be.

name: Curtain layers
description: Parted face-framing layers with soft sides.
stylist_note: Choose a part and framing length you can maintain.

name: Rounded afro
description: A rounded natural silhouette with balanced volume.
stylist_note: Plan shaping, moisture, and detangling around your routine.

name: Shoulder-length layers
description: Layers around shoulder length with flexible styling.
stylist_note: Discuss how much bulk to remove without losing fullness.

name: Long layers
description: Long lengths with gradual layers.
stylist_note: Agree on the shortest layer and the amount of length to keep.

name: Long natural curls
description: Long textured lengths with a shaped outline.
stylist_note: Discuss dry length, shrinkage, and detangling time.

name: Long blunt cut
description: A full, even perimeter with minimal layering.
stylist_note: Check whether your density supports the desired perimeter.

name: Face-framing layers
description: Long layers with shorter sections around the face.
stylist_note: Choose framing lengths that suit your styling habits.

name: Layered long coils
description: A long coily shape with distributed volume.
stylist_note: Discuss shape when dry and your protective nighttime routine.
